title: Men and Women
summary: "Men and Women" by Robert Browning is a collection of fifty-one poems published in 1855. This ambitious work features dramatic monologues spoken by diverse narrators across different historical, religious, and European settings. Each poem presents a distinct voice and perspective, showcasing Browning's mastery of the dramatic monologue form. The final poem, "One Word More," features Browning himself speaking directly to his wife, Elizabeth Barrett Browning.
